_comment: mcp: null = every group, ['jira','jira_write','todos'] = the chosen ones (jira = read, jira_write = Jira writes with the owner's token, jira_hypercare = only create/attach/comment/link, for chats with external users). control_chat: Bob pause/off/on commands only from this chat. epithets: the agent's character traits for this chat, e.g. ['concise','formal','analytical'] - Bob keeps to them in every reply. notes: 'owner' (default) = only the owner may save private notes with 'Bob, remember:'; 'all' = every chat member may. internet: missing/null/false = no access; 'all' = everyone; 'only_me' = the owner only. caller: 'all' = anyone may call Bob; 'owner' = the owner only. persona: 'example' = the example channel persona (prompts/example_persona.md; replaces the base system prompt; list in ai._PERSONA_PROMPTS); missing/null = Bob (default). trigger: a word OR a list of words that call the agent in this chat instead of 'bob' (e.g. 'assistant' or ['assistant','helper']); with caller='auto' it gates only the owner's messages. hold_s: how many seconds to wait before sending an UNPROMPTED reply (one where nobody called the agent by its trigger) - a person may answer meanwhile and then the agent stays silent; replies to an explicit call go at once. missing/0 = no wait. model: the model for this chat instead of the global one (alias haiku/sonnet/opus or a full id, e.g. 'opus'); missing = global (--model / 'Bob, model X'). effort: claude CLI reasoning effort for this chat: low|medium|high|xhigh|max; missing = the CLI default (grill without a setting: high). mcp_extra: a list of opt-in groups added to 'mcp' (also to null = every default). roles: a list of role names from roles.json instead of a hand-written 'mcp' list (a chat with 'roles' ignores 'mcp'); add_groups: groups added to the roles; remove_groups: groups taken away from the roles; external_chat: true = a chat with external users, without 'team_only' groups. ingest_only: true = a listen-only chat: Bob does not reply in it, does not react and sends nothing there (every write path in api_client refuses), not even a scheduled message. Files with the older Polish keys (role, dodatkowo, bez, kanal_fr) still load.
